display.purpose: Hero sections, page-level statements. BioRhyme at its most expressive — never bold, never above 6rem.

headline.purpose: Section headings. Measured authority. Use text-wrap: balance.

body.purpose: General prose. DM Sans at reading weight. Max 75ch.

label.purpose: JetBrains Mono for metadata only — site codes, coordinates, timestamps. Not as decorative scaffolding.

shadows.name: shadow-paper
shadows.purpose: Interactive elevation only. Hovered cards, focused inputs, floating navigation. Never on static elements.

motion.name: ease-brand
motion.purpose: The brand easing curve. Slow entry, fast exit — the feel of a physical thing settling. Used on all buttons and interactive state transitions.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Primary interactive transition duration. Used on buttons, nav, hover states.

motion.name: duration-medium
motion.purpose: Secondary transitions. Used on opacity, colour-only changes.

components.name: Primary Button (dark mode)
components.description: Pill-shaped, wheat-on-bark. The primary CTA in dark mode. 700ms brand easing.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C9A87A; color: #2A1F14; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #EDE8D8; color: #2A1F14; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A87A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Button (light mode)
components.description: Pill-shaped, linen-on-soil. The primary CTA in light mode. Same 700ms brand easing.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-light { background: #6B4C35; color: #F4EFE6; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary-light:hover { background: #2A1F14; color: #F4EFE6; } .ds-btn-primary-light:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary-light:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #556B4E; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent, bordered. Secondary action in both modes.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #C9A87A; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(201, 168, 122, 0.25); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(201, 168, 122, 0.08); border-color: rgba(201, 168, 122, 0.5); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A87A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Double-Bezel Card
components.description: The signature component. Two concentric rounded rectangles — outer translucent shell, inner readable surface. Creates physical depth without shadows.
components.html:
Field Notes

Observations from Auroville, India — 847 hectares restored since 2018.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 2rem; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(237, 232, 216, 0.10); background: rgba(237, 232, 216, 0.04); padding: 0.375rem; } .ds-card-inner { border-radius: calc(2rem - 0.375rem); background: #2A1F14; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding: 2rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'BioRhyme', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 300; color: #EDE8D8; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0 0 0.75rem; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: rgba(237, 232, 216, 0.70); line-height: 1.7; margin: 0; max-width: 65ch; }

components.name: Badge / Ecological Tag
components.description: Rounded pill tag. Lichen sage as default — reads as an ecological classification marker.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #8B9E7A; color: #2A1F14; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.10em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; }

narrative.overview:
Barbets Duet is a global ecological restoration collective. Its interface is a field journal — not a dashboard, not a landing page, not a SaaS product. It carries the precision of scientific observation, the unhurried pace of someone who understands that a forest takes decades to return, and the earthy material weight of handmade things. Every screen is a document that lives in the world, not a UI layer that floats above it.

The system operates in two modes, each a different reading condition for the same journal. Dark mode (the default) is bark at night: deep, warm, quiet, with wheat annotations catching the light. Light mode is linen in morning sun: field notes spread on a wooden table, ink-on-paper clarity, moss and soil for emphasis. Neither mode is correct and the other wrong — they are the same system seen under different skies.

The palette is called Cultivated Simplicity: ten earth tones, all sun-faded, none saturated past the point of nature.
keyCharacteristics: Dark mode primary; light mode an equal peer, not an afterthought
Ten-color palette used at different weights across contexts
BioRhyme at font-weight 200–300 only — never bold headings
700ms brand easing on interactive elements; never linear
Tonal surface layering over box-shadow elevation
Double-Bezel card as the signature component
Floating island navigation — never a full-width header bar
Noise overlay at 4% opacity for analogue grain

rules.name: The Single Flash Rule
rules.body: Wheat (dark mode) and Soil (light mode) are used on ≤10% of any given screen. Their rarity is structural — overuse collapses the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Seasonal Rule
rules.body: Lichen, Clay, and River are seasonal accents. Use one per screen context, never in combination.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: Pure #000000 is prohibited everywhere. On dark surfaces use Bark. This is not an aesthetic preference — it prevents the interface from appearing untethered from its material reference.

rules.name: The BioRhyme Rule
rules.body: BioRhyme is the display and headline font, always. Georgia and serif appear in the font stack as browser fallbacks only — they are never styled independently.

rules.name: The Weight Rule
rules.body: BioRhyme headings use weight 200 (display) or 300 (headline / title). Never font-bold, never font-semibold.

rules.name: The Case Rule
rules.body: Sentence case on all headings, always. JetBrains Mono label/eyebrow is the only UPPERCASE exception, and only when the label is ≤3 words.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. shadow-paper appears only as a state response — hover, focus, or floating. A design that adds shadow to static content has confused weight with importance.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: Coloured outer glows are prohibited. Wheat and Moss do not glow; they illuminate. Tinted diffuse shadows only.

dos: Do use Bark (#2A1F14) everywhere pure black would go.
Do use BioRhyme at weight 200–300 for all display and headline text.
Do use sentence case on all headings and navigation items.
Do use transition: all 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1) on interactive elements.
Do wrap display headings in text-wrap: balance and body paragraphs in text-wrap: pretty.
Do cap body copy at max-w-[65ch] to max-w-[75ch].
Do use the Double-Bezel card (outer shell + CardInner) for elevated content surfaces.
Do keep the floating island nav pill — fixed top-6, backdrop-blur, ring border.
Do use icon strokeWidth={1.5} on all Lucide icons.
donts: Don't use text-white, bg-white, text-black, or bg-black.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient).
Don't place an eyebrow label above every section heading as scaffolding.
Don't use numbered section markers (01 / 02 / 03) as decorative scaffolding.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a coloured accent stripe.
Don't use the three-equal-columns feature card grid.
Don't use the old Night Forest / Neon Lime / Viridian / Platinum palette.
Don't use Inter anywhere in the font stack.
Don't animate top, left, width, or height — only transform and opacity.
